shared_elements: incised/low-relief abstract sign-like motifs on a stone surface
rounded curvilinear shapes with internal loops
signs stacked one above another in a vertical sequence
no recognisable human or animal figures
justification: Both surfaces bear non-figural, rounded curvilinear sign-like motifs carved in low relief and read as a vertical succession of discrete marks, which is the most specific correspondence. But A shows only a few large, loose, crudely pecked outlines scattered on an irregular boulder face, whereas B presents a dense, tightly regulated double column of compact, internally elaborated glyph blocks filling a rectangular field — quite different conventions of scale, density and organisation.
